notes:
New: World Map.

Download your seed's "All Data" zip from valheim-map.world and MegaLoad turns it into a searchable map: every boss altar, dungeon, trader, vegvisir, runestone and chest, with the odds of what each chest can roll. Search for an item (e.g. "Battle Idol") to see every chest that can hold it, nearest spawn first.

Keep as many worlds as you like and switch between them. With Cloud Sync on, finished maps and the trader sites you mark follow you to your other PCs.

Also: Valheim Data shows the upgrade pieces for each crafting station, and MegaLoad opens a little larger.
